subject.title: [Bug] Feishu: message(action=send) renders card JSON as plain text instead of interactive card (regression)

question: Should another Feishu card-JSON fix be attempted only after live Feishu proof is available, or should a maintainer sponsor a proof override/adoption of one of the closed candidate branches?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but multiple direct fixes were closed unmerged after proof concerns, so automation should not keep opening the same repair without maintainer direction on the proof bar.

options.title: Require live proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open and avoid a new automated fix PR until a contributor or maintainer can show a redacted live Feishu send rendering the card correctly.

options.title: Sponsor proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly adopt a known candidate branch and accept focused routing/unit proof in place of live tenant proof.

options.title: Allow a fresh repair
options.body: Queue a new narrow fix only if maintainers confirm the older candidate branches should not be reused and state the expected proof up front.

recommendation.title: Require live proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and avoid a new automated fix PR until a contributor or maintainer can show a redacted live Feishu send rendering the card correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to both the regression-window Feishu message action change and the merged structured native-card payload path.
